qa: It causes that card to also be treated as a Digimon with X000 DP. For example, if a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon, it can attack like a standard Digimon, and it will gain inherited effects from cards stacked under it. However, even if a Tamer is played and then treated as a Digimon in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn.

text_sections.text: [Burst Digivolve] 0 from [ShineGreymon] by returning 1 [Marcus Damon] to hand At the end of the burst digivolution turn, trash this Digimon’s top card

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [When Digivolving] You may play 1 [Marcus Damon] from your hand without paying the cost. For the turn, the Tamer played by this effect is also treated as a 12000 DP Digimon, can't digivolve, and gains ＜Rush＞. [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When one of your Tamers becomes suspended, trash the top card of your opponent’s security stack.
